behavior.memory_contract: comp_pet_behavior_memory_t remains target-owned external user-data payload; portable behavior never writes Flash
behavior.role: portable event and mood state only; it selects a semantic expression but does not compose product pixels

event_bridge.expression_transport: COMP_EPAPER_DISPLAY_REQUEST_EXPRESSION carrying a CEMP player frame
event_bridge.product_state: recording, power and connection states remain semantic behavior inputs; visual frames come only from CEMP
event_bridge.touch: touch and stroke events update portable behavior before the external emote player receives an expression decision

purpose: Machine-checkable current Goal contract for portable pet behavior and approved external-CEMP visual playback.

resource_policy.external: CEMP stores replaceable v9 timelines, menu bases, fonts and larger product assets in ui_assets
resource_policy.internal: application code, behavior state, drivers and parser only; no linked full-frame face arrays or complete code-rendered menu
resource_policy.unavailable: fail closed: keep the existing panel image and report transport/resource failure without drawing a substitute

runtime_guard.expression_maintenance: replay the last external CEMP frame only

visual_baseline.rule: The approved v9 source is the sole inner-face candidate; no legacy, rejected, test, or code-drawn face may substitute for it.

wba_port: Reuse behavior, CEMP/parser and callback-only external-NOR contract; WBA adapters must not revive the retired procedural composer.
